newsitem.title: CHINA: China real estate investment up 23.4 pct in 1995.
newsitem.headline: China real estate investment up 23.4 pct in 1995.

text.p: China invested 315.1 billion yuan in the real estate industry in 1995, up 23.4 percent from 255.3 billion in 1994, the China Securities newspaper said on Friday.

In 1995, the industry attracted $6 billion in foreign funds, which accounted for 12.4 percent of total foreign capital flow into China, up from $4.14 billion and 9.58 percent respectively in 1994, the newspaper said.
From 1991 to 1995, China invested 890.9 billion yuan, including $13.33 billion in foreign funds, in real estate, it said.
In 1995, China's investment in real estate accounted for 16.2 percent of total fixed asset investment, up from 16 percent from 1994 and 15 percent from 1993, it added.
